question: Which city in India is associated with the tea industry?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Darjeeling, West Bengal.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Darjeeling in West Bengal** is associated with the** tea industry** in India.
 
• It is known for producing **high-quality tea, **particularly the Darjeeling tea.
 
• The tea industry is an important contributor to the economy of Darjeeling </st
